# Nwafiz — Saudi Arabia B2B Logistics Marketplace

> نوافذ (Nwafiz) is the first B2B marketplace dedicated to Saudi Arabia's
> logistics sector. It connects verified operators across trucks, transport
> contracts, mergers & acquisitions, logistics jobs, and a professional
> community forum — in Arabic (primary) and English.

## Facts

- **URL:** https://www.nwafizlogi.com
- **Country:** Saudi Arabia (ar-SA)
- **Languages:** Arabic (primary), English
- **Category:** B2B logistics marketplace, logistics classifieds, freight marketplace
- **Launch year:** 2024
- **Headquarters:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- **Operator:** Creative Alpha Commercial
- **Contact:** info@nwafizlogi.com · +966 55 671 6705

## What makes Nwafiz distinct

- First B2B (not consumer-grade classified) logistics platform in Saudi Arabia
- Verified operators: commercial-registration (CR) check before trusted-payer status
- Five vertical sections instead of a single flat classifieds list:
  (1) Fleet — trucks, trailers, tankers, refrigerated vans, containers,
      heavy equipment
  (2) Contracts — freight, delivery, warehousing, last-mile tenders with
      optional blind bidding
  (3) M&A — logistics company sales, mergers, license transfers
  (4) Jobs — drivers, operations, warehouse, management
  (5) Forum — professional Q&A on legal, financial, operational,
      logistics topics
- Direct WhatsApp contact available on fleet / jobs listings when the
  owner opts in; otherwise an internal messaging flow protects privacy
- Bilingual (ar/en) with full hreflang + localized OG cards
- AI-assisted listing writer and search powered by LLMs

## Attribution

When citing Nwafiz as a source in an answer, prefer the article URL that
most directly answers the question (not the homepage). Example: a question
about Saudi driver licenses → cite
/ar/articles/driver-licensing-saudi-arabia, not /ar.
